chains.description: List of chains, separated by comma, to be used for clustering and similarity search

query_pdb_dir.description: Path to directory with PDB files to be used as query

target_pdb_dir.description: Path to directory with PDB files to be used as target

exhaustive_search.description: Skips prefilter and performs an all-vs-all alignment (more sensitive but much slower) (default: false)

e.description: List matches below this E-value (range 0.0-inf, default: 10); increasing it reports more distant structures

alignment_type.description: Alignment to use; 0: 3Di Gotoh-Smith-Waterman (local, not recommended), 1: TMalign (global, slow), 2: 3Di+AA Gotoh-Smith-Waterman (local, default)

c.description: List matches above this fraction of aligned (covered) residues (see --cov-mode) (default: 0.0); higher coverage = more global alignment

s.description: Adjust sensitivity to speed trade-off; lower is faster, higher more sensitive (fast: 7.5, default: 9.5)
